author: Hacktivism
body:
Alright, since this one was built for public servers, not the tournament, it won't have TNT. This is a sequel to my original TM map, "Creta".

Key Features:
- Underground tunnels
- Diagonal map
- Small iron supply
- Two obsidian blocks
- Eleven diamonds per team (two ores and a block)
- Twelve gold blocks per team
